subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as a first Control UI slice after this branch is rebased and contract blockers are fixed, or should the broader calendar/week/editing request stay in design?
rationale: The linked issue requests a wider calendar product surface, while this PR implements a narrower timeline and now crosses current Control UI architecture and cron status contract decisions.

options.title: Accept Narrow Timeline After Rebase
options.body: Adopt the 24-hour timeline as the first core slice once it targets current pages, preserves `cron.status`, and matches scheduler/status/i18n contracts.

options.title: Request A Replacement PR
options.body: Close or pause this stale branch and ask for a fresh implementation against current `ui/src/pages/cron` with the same proof expectations.

options.title: Keep Design Open Only
options.body: Decline this implementation path and keep the canonical issue open until daily, weekly, stats, and editing behavior are specified.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Timeline After Rebase
recommendation.body: Adopt the 24-hour timeline as the first core slice once it targets current pages, preserves `cron.status`, and matches scheduler/status/i18n contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties steipete to both the Cron Jobs UI surface and cron status/service behavior involved in the product-scope choice.
